issue.title: Assert remuxed take audio is non-silent
issue.body:
## Why

`src/audio/aacRemux.test.ts` mocks `AacRemux` and checks that `remuxAacToM4a` is invoked. It does not decode the output. A remux can return a path and still be silent. #707 tracked a silent-playback bug and is closed; this issue is the remaining proof gap called out by #717.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A check decodes a remuxed take and fails when the samples are silent or the container is unreadable.
- [ ] The check uses a known non-silent fixture. A missing fixture is BLOCKED, not a pass.

Refs #717. Android only. Do not treat a mocked module call as audio proof.
